headline: Tue Oct 27: NBA 3-0. CFB Missouri State pending, Delaware withdrawn. No NFL games.

findings: No NFL games Tuesday. Week 8 starts Thursday night. The board stays empty until Thursday's refresh posts rosters and injuries, by design.

checks.text: Grading between weeks fixed (#35). Before it, a refresh with no new-week rankings skipped grading, which is why Monday night showed late.
Week 8 pregame sims are saved for all 14 games and get re-run and re-frozen at each refresh until kickoff.

postgame: Season to date, the NFL top 10 is 10-2 (83%) and picks of the day are 3-1. The Week 7 re-sim findings (carry share above input, RB target share low) are being watched in the Week 8 reviews before any correction.
improving: Week 8 sims use the volume corrections learned from Weeks 4-7 (passes x1.029, runs x0.997). Efficiency corrections are retested every refresh and adopted only when they clear the test.

results.actual: Withdrawn before kickoff: the model now backs the other side

findings: Delaware to win (51%) was withdrawn before kickoff because the model flipped sides once fresh prices came in. Without the new rule it would have been a coin-flip pick of the day.
The new 60% floor also pulled Wednesday's Middle Tennessee (59%) and Jacksonville State (53%) picks, so there's no college pick of the day tonight. Thursday's is North Texas to win (83%, ML -490).
Missouri State to win (71%, ML -220) vs Sam Houston is waiting on the final from the college score feed.

checks.text: The college score feed (cfbfastR) runs about a day behind for weeknight games, so Missouri State grades on tomorrow's refresh.
College moneylines are now read from ESPN's current prices, and stale book prices are dropped from line shopping (#35). The Delaware pick had been locked on a stale price.

postgame: Saturday's top 10 stands 15-3 and picks of the day 3-0. Weeknight MAC/C-USA games are mostly near coin flips, so few qualify for the 60% floor.
improving: Monday review tests (lock totals at the earliest posted line; shootout signals) roll into next Monday's report. Nothing new shipped to the college model today.

results.actual: Finished with 1 (graded from the box score by hand; the site grades it on the next refresh)
Finished with 6 (graded from the box score by hand; the site grades it on the next refresh)
Finished with 2 (graded from the box score by hand; the site grades it on the next refresh)

findings: A clean 3-0 on the four-game slate: Duncan Robinson over 1.5 assists (2) and Day'Ron Sharpe under 8.5 rebounds (6) as picks of the day, and Egor Demin under 3.5 rebounds (1) on the top 10.
All 315 graded leans: 63% hit (199-116). Leans at 65%+ hit 79% (114 picks), but coin flips and 55-60% leans went under 50% (48% and 49%). Those tiers stay off the picks, as they should.
Biggest misses were stars outplaying unders: Michael Porter Jr. (27 points in 40 minutes vs 30 projected), Luka Doncic (41 points vs 37.5), and Robert Williams III (14 points vs 6.1 projected).

checks.text: At 4 am the free box-score feed only had games through Mon Oct 26, so Tuesday's picks couldn't be graded yet. They have posted since (all 4 games) and grade on the next refresh.

The 5:30 am official injury report still read no players (the PDF now splits one word per line). Fixed in #39 at 6:29 am, so tonight's pre-tip refresh reads it. Until then the ESPN list (27 teams) was used.

Team scoring check, 12 games today: it scaled down rotations that add up too high from long injury lists (PHI 151 projected vs 109 usual, x0.90; MIL 141, x0.92; IND 130; WSH 129) and scaled up thin ones (LAC 65, x1.09; OKC 74, x1.06).
No posted NBA prop lines on the free odds plan (285 credits left), so picks of the day are stars at DraftKings-posted lines only (#37).

postgame: Minutes: players averaged 1.8 fewer minutes than projected (typical miss 6.2). Re-run with real minutes, 57 of the 116 losses would have been right.
Points ran +0.7 per player above projections on Tuesday, while rebounds ran −0.4. Monday leaned the other way, so this is noise for now. We'll act on a bias only if it holds for a week.
improving: Morning refit: all 5 markets validated again on 139k unseen player-games. The correlation model for parlays stays on (pairs gain +0.0010, CI above 0).
From Oct 28, picks of the day need a 60%+ chance, and locked picks are withdrawn before tip if they fall under that or the model flips sides (#38).
